figures.Fig16.6: Figure 16.6 Procedure of titration (PDF page 341). Original figure archived as c11-chem-ch16-fig-16-6-titration-procedure (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The printed figure labels the pipette 'Acid solution' and ends with a pink flask (acid in the flask, base in the burette), contradicting the book's procedure (NaOH pipetted, HCl in the burette, phenolphthalein pink to colourless); drawn as NaOH solution in the pipette, pink after the indicator and colourless at the end point (correct).
